# docs/archive/

Historical documentation that has been superseded, completed, or is no longer
operationally relevant. Retained for reference only.

**Do not edit files in this directory.**
**Do not reference these files in active documentation.**

## Contents

| Directory | Contains |
|-----------|----------|
| `survey-2026-05/` | Survey module development reports from May 2026 (module now in production) |
| `kpi-audits-2026-05/` | KPI rating system audit reports from May 2026 (issues resolved) |
| `kpi-implementation-2026-05/` | KPI assistant implementation notes and exploration reports from May 2026 |
| `reports-2026-05/` | General audit reports and AI-generated analysis from May 2026 |

## Archive Policy

Files are moved here when they are:
- Superseded by newer documentation
- Historically valuable but no longer actionable
- Related to completed implementation phases
- Generated reports from one-time audit sessions

Files are NOT deleted (to preserve history) but should not be confused with
active operational documentation found in the parent `docs/` directories.
